parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human CB1 receptor (CHEMBL218) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL218 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require structures via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Alias identifier as compound_chembl_id. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
